name: currency_convert
description: Real-time currency conversion tool. Input: amount (number), from currency (ISO 4217 string), to currency (ISO 4217 string). Output: converted_amount (number, 2dp), rate (number), from (string), to (string), original_amount (number), timestamp (ISO 8601 string), source (string). Fetches live exchange rates. Supports all major fiat currency pairs.

amount.description: Monetary amount to convert. Positive number greater than zero.

from.description: Source currency. ISO 4217 three-letter code. e.g. USD, GBP, EUR, JPY.

to.description: Target currency. ISO 4217 three-letter code. e.g. EUR, CHF, JPY, GBP.
